note: Bookshop creator-referral detection + unwrap. Migrated from isBookshopPathReferral() (cleaner.js:274-277) (issue #625). drop-affiliate-injection (PR 1a): the injectPath/injectParam/injectValue/affiliateIdSource fields (MUGA's own ?affiliate=124046 injection on /p/ product pages) were REMOVED — MUGA never inserts its own affiliate tag anymore. Only the referralPaths + unwrapReferral fields remain, driving getPathAffiliatePolicy() in src/lib/path-rules.js (creator-referral detection + unwrap, consumed by processUrl() in src/lib/cleaner.js). #959: when stripAllAffiliates is ON, the /a/CREATOR/DEST wrapper is UNWRAPPED to DEST (foreign creator attribution removed) using 'unwrapReferral' (capture group 1 is the destination path, or an embedded same-origin absolute URL); DEST is never re-tagged afterward. /shop/NAME never unwraps (unwrapReferral only matches /a/.../..., never /shop/...), so a bookstore's own storefront is never touched. When stripAllAffiliates is OFF, behavior is unchanged: /a/ paths are preserved exactly (honor-creator).
